headline: Turn month-end billing exceptions into an approval-ready close
capabilities: Validate time entries/billing rules and generate invoices
Complete missing descriptions and classify billable hours
Flag disputed hours, premium billing, and budget overruns
Generate CFO-ready revenue recognition reports and audit trails
outcomes: Reduced billing cycles from multi-day process to minutes
Achieved a higher billable rate via accurate classification
Protected revenue by recovering disputed hours and preventing leakage
Delivered audit-ready invoices and compliance documentation
why_try: The demo shows exactly why work is blocked and separates invoice-ready support from entries that still need narrative, approval, or milestone evidence.

sample_prompts.label: Find close blockers
sample_prompts.prompt: What billable work is still blocked from this close, and what has to happen before it can move?

sample_prompts.label: Review the billing rollup
sample_prompts.prompt: Give me the month-end billing rollup by project and consultant without treating it as posted revenue.

sample_prompts.label: Audit time cards
sample_prompts.prompt: Which time cards would fail our billing review because of narrative, hours, rate, or budget concerns?

sample_prompts.label: Prepare eligible invoice support
sample_prompts.prompt: Prepare the invoice support that is actually ready, and keep anything without the right approval or milestone evidence out.

sample_prompts.label: Resolve disputed-hour evidence
sample_prompts.prompt: What evidence is missing on the disputed hours, and what is the safest resolution path before we go back to the clients?
